_comment: SHA-256 of every artifact one full evaluation run of the tiny fixture emits, captured once so a later refactor of the evaluation package can be proved to move no number. Read by tests/test_eval_binding.py. This file is a one-time capture: it must not be regenerated to make that gate pass.

normalisation.pdf: the embedded /CreationDate is blanked before hashing: matplotlib stamps every figure with the wall clock, and the drawing itself is byte-identical without it
normalisation.npz: hashed over the arrays in sorted key order rather than over the zip container, whose member order follows the interpreter's hash seed

excluded.eval.log: every line carries a wall-clock timestamp
excluded.summary.json: carries durations, the absolute checkpoint and output paths, and the numeric environment; its results block is compared structurally instead
excluded.preflight.json: carries the absolute checkpoint path and the resolved shard list; its causality record is compared structurally instead
excluded.collection.json: the provenance sidecar names the absolute checkpoint path
excluded.resolved_config.yaml: the merged config carries the absolute shard, statistics and output paths
excluded.band_partition.json: records the absolute path of the shard whose channel map it read

causality.statement: The source-conditioned KL is a coupling readout, NOT a transfer entropy and NOT causal. The input features come from two-sided filters whose forward reach is bounded by a 95%-energy quantile rather than by a hard support, so a feature at step t carries energy from its own future under every configured budget -- max_channel_reach_s records how far the longest-reaching channel of this feature bank looks ahead, and under the shipped causal_reach_budget_s: null no channel is pruned and no delay is applied at all. No number in this run may be labelled a transfer entropy.

calibration.reason: calibration needs a predictive distribution; this checkpoint was trained under likelihood='mse', whose decoder log-variance head is never fitted, so a probability integral transform of it would be arithmetic over an untrained tensor

verdicts.name: predictive_improvement
verdicts.detail: the source-conditioned forecast scores better than the target-only one.

verdicts.name: source_specificity
verdicts.detail: the ordering does not hold, so a nonzero KL cannot be read as source-specific coupling.

verdicts.name: prior_carries_target_state
verdicts.detail: a stranger's prior latent forecasts this recording as well as its own, so the prior is not carrying the target's predictive state and every readout built on that reading is unsupported.

verdicts.name: latent_not_collapsed
verdicts.detail: the KL is spread over more than one or two latent dimensions.

verdicts.name: prior_variance_not_pinned
verdicts.criterion: the prior log-variance within its clamp margin for < 0.5 of the masked support
verdicts.detail: the prior variance is off its clamp, so the KL's denominator is a fitted quantity rather than a bound.

verdicts.name: decoder_variance_not_pinned
verdicts.criterion: the decoder log-variance within its clamp margin for < 0.5 of the masked support
verdicts.detail: the decoder variance is off both clamps.

verdicts.name: calibration_near_nominal
verdicts.criterion: observed central coverage at 1/2/3 sigma within 0.5 relative tail error of erf(k/sqrt(2))
verdicts.detail: this run scored no Gaussian observation model, so there is no predictive distribution to calibrate -- an 'mse' checkpoint reaches here.

cohort.non_comparability: a forecast score from this evaluation is not comparable with a test_* metric logged during training: they are computed over different populations, and nothing in either number says so
cohort.out_of_distribution: the evaluation cohort is disjoint from the training cohort, so this is a leakage-free evaluation -- and the checkpoint has never seen the unseen subgroups listed beside this sentence, so every class contrast is an out-of-distribution comparison rather than held-out clinical discrimination

coverage.note: a scattering channel has no recoverable centre frequency when no selected phase pair referenced its filter, which happens outside the phase selection's own band; those channels are placed in the 'unknown' band rather than guessed

kl_space.note: descriptive only: a stranger's source is out of distribution for a posterior trained on matched pairs, so a healthy model moves the posterior *more* under the control. The specificity criterion is decided in prediction space and cannot read this.

metrics.meaning: RMS of mu_full - mu_base per scored raw sample: how far the source moved the forecast, which is not the same as how much it improved it
per-element RMS of mu_post - mu_prior over the KL's anchor support
L2 norm of mu_post - mu_prior per step, summed over d_z before the mean -- the size of the belief shift, larger than the per-element figure by sqrt(d_z)

residual.caveat: both forecasts come from one shared decoder and one shared log-variance head applied to two different latents, not from two separate variance heads -- so the difference between them understates how differently the two latents are read, in the model's favour

estimator.detrend: constant, per window, each series independently
estimator.scaling: P_k = c_k * conj(X_k) * Y_k / (nperseg * U) with U = sum(w^2) and c_0 = c_Nyq = 1, else 2. A spectrum here is a variance in z^2, NOT a density: there is no delta-f divisor, which is what makes Parseval a plain sum over bins and hence over bands. Because each window's mean is removed, the spectrum says nothing about the forecast's level.

seam.note: a ratio far above one on a branch, with the truth's near one, is power at the decoder's token boundary rather than in the fetal heart rate; it sits inside the 'mf' band and contaminates it

coherence.source_coherence_note: source coherence is measured against the CONTEMPORANEOUS uterine pressure -- the pressure during the window being forecast, which the model never read, since it conditions on the source only up to each anchor. It is a linear-association and timing statement between two traces, not a directed or causal one, and the run's causality disclosure applies to it exactly as to every other readout here.
coherence.segment_mean_note: every ..._segment_mean column is the estimator this analysis does NOT use -- per-segment ratios averaged -- emitted so the coherence's small-sample bias is a measured number rather than an assumed one

metrics.meaning: per-segment RMSE of the source-conditioned forecast over its scored raw samples
the same for the target-only forecast; the pair says how much of a cohort's error the source pathway removed
the source-conditioned block score: accuracy and confidence together, summed over the 480-sample block
the headline coupling readout per segment; zero is the null and the reference line marks it
the unfloored KL between the two latents; readable as a rate only while the prior variance is off its clamp
per-element RMS of mu_post - mu_prior: how far the source moved the belief. Already rooted by the collection pass, so it is drawn as it is stored
the decoder's mean log-variance per segment; the reference marks sigma = 1 z-unit
how spread the lag attention was; readable against the attainable ceiling rather than on its own

distributions.descriptive_only: descriptive only: these are distributions, not tests. No p-value, interval or verdict is computed here and nothing from this analysis enters the headline block -- a visible separation between cohorts is a reason to look rather than a result, and cross_subgroup is the analysis that decides whether one survives being asked properly, on per-recording values
distributions.per_segment_root_note: the segment-level series of a rooted metric is the root of each segment's own mean square, while the recording-level series roots after the per-recording mean as the rest of this pipeline does; by Jensen the first sits at or below the second, so the mean of the filled distribution is not this pipeline's headline RMSE and must not be quoted as one

readouts.meaning: Monte Carlo marginalised D_base - D_full in nats per anchor; in the decoder's own units and immune to the prior-variance inflation
the unfloored KL between the two latents; inflated by an arbitrary factor whenever the prior variance sits on its clamp, which is why it is not read alone

pooled.note: pooled across every window, so a difference here can be an artifact of the classes covering the time-to-delivery axis unequally rather than a difference in coupling; it is context and is consumed by nothing

significance.method: Per time-before-delivery window: Kruskal-Wallis across clinical classes over one value per recording, Holm step-down correction across the windows as one family, pairwise two-sided Mann-Whitney U with Cliff's delta for the windows significant after Holm only. Non-parametric throughout. Classes with fewer than 3 recordings in a window are excluded from it and recorded. The pooled row ignores time and is confounded by unequal class coverage of the axis.

Non-parametric throughout. Classes with fewer than 3 recordings in a window are excluded from it and recorded. The pooled row ignores time and is confounded by unequal class coverage of the axis.

deceleration.deduplication: rates are computed per (event, horizon step); for a fixed step exactly one anchor places a given raw sample there, so each physiological event is counted once per step rather than once per anchor

triggered.reason: 1 usable contraction(s) of 1 detected over 1 recording(s); the triggered average needs at least 20 over 4, below which the curve is a description of whichever recordings happened to contribute

conditioned.onset_convention: contraction onsets are the corrected rising-edge walk-back; the sibling stage-2 probe's walk-back starts at the peak, where the smoothed gradient is already below threshold, and therefore reports the peak index as the onset

subgroup.reason: the per-sample frame carries no 'subgroup' column

extra_encoder_pass.reason: a probe fit is thousands of passes over the same segments, and the encoder state they read is on neither durable table

metrics.meaning: block score in nats per anchor, lower is better

metrics.label: target-only (base)
metrics.meaning: block score in nats per anchor, lower is better

metrics.label: source-conditioned (full)
metrics.meaning: block score in nats per anchor, lower is better

metrics.label: mc_nll_base_block - nll_oracle_block
metrics.meaning: context-sufficiency gap D_base - D_oracle: what the latent bottleneck costs the forecast, as an estimate biased in two unmeasured directions

metrics.label: mc_nll_base_block - mc_nll_full_block
metrics.meaning: the coupling readout D_base - D_full on the same held-out recordings, so the two gaps are drawn against one denominator

convergence.detail: the final quarter of the fit contributed 0.6136 of the 0.8289 nats/anchor the held-out score improved by (74.0%, threshold 10%)

capacity.detail: doubling the probe's width moved the held-out score by -0.839 nats/anchor against a 1 nat margin, so the reported gap is not width-limited

wide_fit.convergence_detail: the held-out score never improved on its first evaluation (483.3 nats/anchor); the probe did not fit

bias_directions.cause: the probe conditions on target_state rather than on the raw target history, so it inherits the encoder's own information loss and cannot recover what the encoder already discarded -- the measured gap is therefore the bottleneck's cost alone, not the whole context-sufficiency gap

the probe is fitted on the evaluation population while D_base comes from a model trained on the disjoint, healthier pretraining cohort, so the probe does not suffer the domain shift the production decoder does and part of the gap is that shift rather than the bottleneck

sufficiency.estimate_not_a_bound: Delta_suff is an estimate, not a bound: one bias direction understates it and the other overstates it, neither is measured, and no arithmetic here resolves them.

cross_subgroup.method: Kruskal-Wallis across cohorts per metric over one value per recording; Holm step-down correction across the metrics in the family; pairwise two-sided Mann-Whitney U with Cliff's delta for the metrics significant after Holm only. Non-parametric throughout because these distributions are skewed and heavy-tailed. Cohorts with fewer than 3 finite recordings are excluded and recorded rather than entered.

headline.pred_gap_convention: pred_gap_mc_nats is the headline: the Monte Carlo marginalised block score difference D_base - D_full in nats per anchor, where D = -[logsumexp_r(-D_r) - log K] is the log of the average likelihood over K latent draws. pred_gap_train_path_nats is the single-draw training-path difference, reported beside it as the objective-parity column. Three percentage columns restate the same finding as a proportion, each computed per recording and then averaged: pred_gap_rmse_pct and pred_gap_mse_pct are the percentage of the target-only branch's point-forecast error the source removed, in root-mean-square and mean-square respectively, and are scale-free; pred_gap_mc_likelihood_pct is 100*(exp(pred_gap_mc_nats / (H*R)) - 1), the extra probability density the source-conditioned forecast puts on each observed raw sample, where H*R is the fixed block size rather than a per-anchor scored-sample count and so understates the improvement wherever forecast steps are masked. That third column exists only under gaussian_nll: under mse a block score is a sum of squared errors rather than a log density, so it is null there rather than exponentiated into a density ratio that would not be one. None of the three is pred_gap divided by a block score: a log score has no natural zero, D_base is legitimately negative for a sharp forecast, and that ratio would change sign with its own denominator.

kl_identity.detail: the per-dimension KL sums to the raw source-conditioned KL

argmax_lag.detail: the argmax lag is 0, so the attribution never looks back and the lag window is inert

lag_map_sums_to_kl.detail: the per-lag KL attribution sums over lags to the per-step KL it attributes, to 0.000114 nats on the worst anchor of the pass

per_head_kl_sums_to_kl.detail: the per-head KL sums over heads to the per-step KL it decomposes, to 0.000114 nats on the worst anchor of the pass

coherence_parseval.detail: the band-summed residual spectrum matches the windowed time-domain residual to 8.03005e-16

coherence_detrended_share.detail: the detrended residual power is 0.99819 of the raw residual power, within the factor of 2 this check allows; the complement is the forecast's level error, which the spectrum does not see

target_not_truncated.detail: 144 of 7152 nonzero target value(s) are fractional, as a fractional weight requires

headline_finite.detail: all 38 reported headline scalar(s) are finite
